lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters organized into vertical columns. The centroids exhibit equidistant vertical spacing within columns, while horizontal spacing between columns varies across the mid-lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming grid-like anchor nodes primarily visible in the mid-flank region posterior to the branchial area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light on the dorsal edge to a deeper shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of small, lower-intensity circular blobs, particularly concentrated along the leading edge and distal tip.
